integrity: The radius is covered by an earlier general cut formula. New claim is the exact complete center locus, parity dichotomy, and the sharp even-part order threshold. Proof is analytical; finite computational checks corroborate selected cases. Historical priority is provisional and independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unweighted complete bipartite graphs with smaller part at least four, embedded with centered root vectors and the intrinsic Euclidean metric. No vertex census is claimed in the genuine truncated phase.
title: Parity and a sharp facet transition in biclique graphical-zonotope incenter loci
